# Pillos Co., Ltd.

> Korean ocean carrier established in 2009, specializing in dry bulk, gas (LPG/olefin), and chemical tanker shipping across global trade routes.

Pillos (㈜필로스, Pillos Shipping) is a Korean ocean carrier headquartered in Seoul, operating since 2009. It moves industrial raw materials, energy, and chemical cargo for steelmakers, power utilities, petrochemical producers, and global trading houses.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Pillos Co., Ltd. / 주식회사 필로스
- Founded: 2009, Seoul, South Korea
- CEO: In Ewon Rhee (이인원)
- Head office: 7th Floor, 9 Chungmu-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, 04554, Korea
- Phone: +82-2-318-1703 · Fax: +82-2-318-1706
- Email: info@pillos.co.kr
- Industry: Ocean shipping — dry bulk, gas (LPG/olefin), chemical tanker
- Association memberships: Korea Shipping Association (since 2016), Korea Shipowners' Association (since 2018)
- Service areas: Korea, Japan, China, Southeast Asia, India, Australia, Russia, the Americas

## What Pillos carries
- Dry bulk: coal, iron ore, grain, steel products, cement, minerals (Handysize to Kamsarmax)
- Gas: LPG, olefin gases (ethylene, propylene, butadiene), VCM, on purpose-built carriers
- Chemical: benzene, base oils, hydrochloric acid, on dedicated chemical tankers
